title: Speed Measurement
source_docs: Motor Control Blockset HDL Support/Sensor Decoders/Speed_Measurement.md
text: Compute speed from rotor angular position, 2 inputs, 1 output, {Speed calculation criteria} sets Method of; {Position unit} sets the unit of angular, {Position scaling datatype} sets the range for mapping input, {Discrete step size (s)} sets the sample time after which block executes again, {Maximum application speed (RPM)} sets the maximum measurable rotor speed, {Speed Resolution (RPM)} sets the minimum detectable speed 5e-6, {Delays for speed calculation (number of samples)} sets the number of angular position samples measured, {Maximum measurable speed (RPM)} sets the maximum measurable speed, {Measurable speed resolution (RPM)} sets the minimum speed resolution used for speed computation 4.6566e-07, {Speed unit} sets the unit of angular, {Per unit speed (RPM)} sets the speed, {Speed data type} sets the data type of angular speed and {Use input port for Discrete step size} sets the sample step size with input port. Values come from the instance.
